parsed.refutation_attempt: SIZE is defined as a compile-time macro constant (line 4). The value 1000000 is not influenced by any external input, so it cannot be manipulated by an attacker. The expression SIZE * sizeof(double) therefore evaluates to a compile-time constant of 8,000,000 bytes, which is far below the maximum value representable by size_t on modern platforms. Consequently there is no integer overflow or wraparound possible at this allocation site.
